sorrowful.linePrev: I wonder why we listen to poets when nobody gives a fuck
sorrowful.line: How hot and sorrowful, this machine begs for luck
sorrowful.lineNext: All my lies are always wishes
stanza: The cash machine is blue and green
For a hundred in twenties and a small service fee
I could spend three dollars and sixty-three cents
On Diet Coca-Cola and unlit cigarettes
I wonder why we listen to poets when nobody gives a fuck
How hot and sorrowful, this machine begs for luck

sorrowful.linePrev: Because it seems that it's always changing
sorrowful.line: The wind's indecision, the sorrowful rain
sorrowful.lineNext: Yeah, I was a postcard, I was a record
stanza: Well if I could tame all of my desires
Wait out the weather that howls in my brain
Because it seems that it's always changing
The wind's indecision, the sorrowful rain
